title: A burst of worker session ends does not lose usage rows behind the Pusher's run under the distill lock
goal: A --session distill that waits USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S for a lock a Pusher run holds still writes its usage rows (a retry, or deliver kept off for a worker's end), measured on one Pusher run's duration

run:
import sys, tempfile, threading, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import ql_distill, ql_base
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
qdir = tmp / "q"
(qdir / "spool").mkdir(parents=True)
calls = []
ql_distill.add_usage = lambda spool, sid, tp, skip=None: calls.append(sid) or 1
ql_distill.close_ended = lambda *a: None
ql_distill._distill = lambda *a, **k: 0
ql_distill.USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S = 0.3
ql_distill.USAGE_LOCK_POLL_S = 0.1
held = ql_base.acquire(qdir)
assert held is not None
def free():
    time.sleep(1.2)
    ql_base.release(held)
threading.Thread(target=free, daemon=True).start()
ql_distill.distill(qdir=qdir, cfg=tmp / "cfg.json", usage_from=("sess1", str(tmp / "t.jsonl")), out=lambda *a: None, deliver=None)
end = time.time() + 4
while not calls and time.time() < end:
    time.sleep(0.1)
assert calls == ["sess1"], calls
